author: permaculturegeek
body: Only really useable with classes with high tenacity - unable to die from self-inflicted debuff- caused damage, so Realmshifter or Deity families. I did try it (accidentally) with a beoH Crit build, and recharge kept me alive, but I had little ward. I was too focused on survival to notice how much extra damage I was doing.
